source_anchor: Only the literal Gaussian-formula signed Haar average in Ex58 and the following norm-axis exponent evaluation. It closes the orthogonal-transitivity/coordinate adapter from fixed-Q invariance to the explicitly displayed function of U=O11 and Euclidean norm. Actual Gaussian probability-law/density identification, spatial domination/Fubini and H(lambda), sphere/Poisson/TV/main bounds are excluded.

proposed_signatures.signed_kernel_radial:
theorem signed_kernel_radial {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun O v => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(v ⬝ᵥ (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ v)) / 2)
    let r : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(κ + 1 - (κ - 1) * (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0) *
            ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 4)
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * p O (WithLp.ofLp x)) (orthogonalHaar n) ∧
      Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * r O x) (orthogonalHaar n) ∧
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * p O (WithLp.ofLp x) ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * r O x ∂orthogonalHaar n)

meaning_definitions.singleBlockPrecision: Same existing literal Eq4 matrix, no replacement.
meaning_definitions.orthogonalHaar: Same actual normalized Borel probability on the full real O(n), including both determinant signs.
meaning_definitions.p: Literal real Gaussian precision formula; no probability law is constructed or characterized.
meaning_definitions.r: Literal value of that formula at ||x||e1 after source axis quadratic-form evaluation. Index1 is represented by zero-based j0.
meaning_definitions.space: EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) has Euclidean norm; WithLp.ofLp gives the real coordinate vector. No sup-norm replacement. Every dimension-half exponent is real division.
